worldModel.surfaceLaw: A supported Agent application surface owns mechanical Harness composition, not caller/domain semantics. The caller supplies exact Run Contract, chooses Provider via a Contract-bound Adapter factory, supplies external Runtime execution authority when required, and selects exact initial cognition. Harness owns state-root Store opening, Continuity reconstruction, built-in bridge composition, Contract-budget reconstruction and Snapshot-bound resume provenance.
worldModel.reopenLaw: Fresh-process reopen/resume requires state root, Harness Run identity and caller Provider factory plus any explicit external execution authority. Callers do not load pause snapshots, derive provider_source, instantiate Continuity/Bridge or reconstruct RunBudget.
worldModel.preAdmissionLaw: HarnessAgentRun.create performs pure structural admission, then exact Adapter identity/model resolution, before creating the state root or durable Run. Unsupported Tool surface, missing/forbidden Runtime authority or Adapter mismatch therefore leaves no partial Run and does not construct Provider for structurally invalid input.
worldModel.providerChoiceLaw: On open, Harness loads the exact persisted Contract then passes it to the caller-supplied Adapter factory. Harness binds Provider choice but does not choose it.
worldModel.runtimeAuthorityLaw: Runtime workspace identity, runtime-binding digest and foreign references are never inferred. Built-in Tool-bearing composition requires caller-supplied HarnessExecutionBinding and HarnessRuntimeClient; custom Tool surfaces fail closed to advanced core composition.
worldModel.cognitionLaw: HarnessCognitionProfile, HarnessCognitionSeed, HarnessCognitionSeedSource and HarnessCognitionSource expose exact caller-owned bootstrap state without discovery, ranking, summarization or automatic retention.
worldModel.kernelBoundary: AgentTurnProjector, CognitionAdmissionKernel and ProviderCallLifecycle remain internal and absent from the recommended API. R3 composes through them without exposing them.
worldModel.compatibilityLaw: R3.1 is additive. Existing low-level recommended exports remain available; narrowing that facade is deferred to a later evidence-gated R3 slice.

conclusion: R3.1 establishes a supported Agent Run product surface over the R0-R2 mechanisms. Normal Python callers now execute/reopen/resume from a state root without persistence/Continuity/Bridge/budget/provider-source wiring, while Contract, Provider choice, external Runtime authority and exact cognition selection remain explicit caller-owned inputs. CLI run/resume adopts the same handle; 294 tests/full wheel/local acceptance pass on a byte-identical source/tests/docs tree; and real DeepSeek cognition promotion succeeds through the recommended API.
knownLimits: Automatic bridge composition is intentionally limited to canonical no-Tool and existing independent Runtime-search surfaces; custom/domain bridges remain advanced core composition.
Earlier low-level Store/Continuity/StandaloneRunner exports remain in the recommended API in R3.1 for compatibility; pruning is deferred.
HarnessAgentRun is per-Run composition, not cross-Run memory/orchestration or Provider recommendation.
HarnessCognitionSource aliases the existing HarnessWorkingViewSource representation so there is one source schema/digest truth.
The inherited no-VPN Tool continuity experiment was not physically rerun after R3 because its checker scope became stale; it remains historical evidence rather than a current R3 claim.
